description_en: Modifies the elastic scaling configuration of an instance
description_zh: 调用ModifyAutoScalingConfig接口，修改实例弹性伸缩功能配置
name: ModifyAutoScalingConfig

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to apply the configurations under the Spec configuration item for the specification elastic scaling feature:

true: Yes.
false: No
fields.help_zh:
是否应用规格弹性伸缩功能配置项Spec下的配置：

true：是。
false：否
fields.name: apply

fields.help_en:
The cool-down period. The parameter value consists of a number and a time unit suffix. The supported database instances and valid values are as follows. The time suffix m indicates minutes, h indicates hours, and d indicates days:

PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition: 5m, 10m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 3h, 1d, and 7d.
ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL high availability series cloud disk edition: 5m, 10m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 3h, 1d, and 7d
fields.help_zh:
静默期。参数值由数值和时间单位后缀组成，支持的数据库实例及其取值如下，其中时间单位后缀m表示分钟，h表示小时，d：表示天：

PolarDB MySQL版的集群版：5m、10m、30m、1h、2h、3h、1d、7d。
RDS MySQL高可用系列云盘版：5m、10m、30m、1h、2h、3h、1d、7d
fields.name: cool_down_time

fields.help_en:
The threshold of average CPU utilization that triggers automatic specification scale-up. Unit: %. Valid values:

50
60
70
80
90

<notice>You must set this parameter when the target database instance is PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition or ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL high availability series cloud disk edition.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:
触发规格自动扩容的CPU平均利用率阈值，单位为%，取值：

50
60
70
80
90

<notice>目标数据库实例为PolarDB MySQL版的集群版、RDS MySQL高可用系列云盘版时，需要设置本参数。
</notice>
fields.name: cpu_usage_upper_threshold

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether automatic specification scale-down is enabled:
true: Yes.
false: No.

<notice>You must set this parameter when the target database instance is PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition or ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL high availability series cloud disk edition.
</notice>

<notice>目标数据库实例为PolarDB MySQL版的集群版、RDS MySQL高可用系列云盘版时，需要设置本参数。

fields.help_en:
The maximum number of read-only nodes for the instance.

<notice>You must set this parameter when the target database instance is PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:
实例只读节点数的最大值。

<notice>目标数据库实例为PolarDB MySQL版的集群版时，需要设置本参数。
</notice>
fields.name: max_read_only_nodes

fields.help_en:
The upper limit of the specification for automatic scale-up. You can only scale up to a higher specification within the same series of the database instance. For more details, see the specification documentation for each database instance:
<props="china">

For PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html.
For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL high availability series cloud disk edition, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276974.html.
For Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) cloud-native (formerly cloud disk) open-source edition, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144986.html.

</props>

<props="intl">

For PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html.
For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL high availability series cloud disk edition, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276974.html.

</props>
fields.help_zh:
自动扩容的规格上限。仅支持扩容到数据库实例同系列的更高规格，详情请参见各数据库实例的产品规格文档：
<props="china">

PolarDB MySQL版的集群版请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html。
RDS MySQL高可用系列云盘版请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276974.html。
Redis云原生（原云盘）开源版请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144986.html。

</props>

<props="intl">

PolarDB MySQL版的集群版请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html。
RDS MySQL高可用系列云盘版请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276974.html。

</props>

Standard SSDs are retired. https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/314678.html
